notes: Inbound SMB lead focused on hosted_api self-serve. Primary product is a ticket routing + canned-response system for SMB retailers. Very cost conscious; mentions token/unit cost repeatedly. Key quote from CTO: "We need near real-time responses for chat (aim ~200-400ms server-side) but can trade down to cheaper models for low-value flows." Asks: clear guidance on Llama vs Mistral vs Qwen variants for quality vs cost, recommended quantization levels, expected latency on public cloud GPUs for 7B/13B/30B families. Wants to avoid early Dedicated commitment — prefers hosted first. Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2 report, and audit logs required. Proposed trial: run two model variants over realistic ticket corpus (5k tickets) for 7 days, measure P95 latency, token cost, and F1 on intent classification prompts. Notes from SE: suggest Llama-2-13B-4bit quant and Qwen-7B-8k as starting points; Mistral-instruct 7B could be cheaper but may need prompt tuning. use_case_summary: Customer: SMB retailers using chat/ticketing. Need hosted API for support assistant + ticket summarization. Targets: p95 latency 200-400ms, throughput roughly 30-60 reqs/min peak per instance, strong cost sensitivity. Model question: want guidance on picking between Llama, Mistral, Qwen families and which quantization yields best quality/cost tradeoff for short-turn chat and reranking tasks.
